user.title: To-do Sync
user.description: Choose two to-do lists whose open items should be synchronized. Set the sync interval and optional cleanup and title handling below. You can change these settings later.

data.split_title: Automatically split titles into name and description

data_description.interval: How often To-do Sync checks both lists automatically.
data_description.remove_duplicates: Completes extra open copies of the same item, keeping one open copy per list.
data_description.split_title: For lists without description support, use the first word as the item name and the rest as its description. Turn this off to keep the full title as the item name.

abort.already_configured: This pair of lists is already configured.
